messages:
sam: FYI customer 'Pacific Labs' invoice #INV-6832 charged NY sales tax even though PO lists Pacific Labs LLC (CA) and 'CA Resale Cert' attached. Client says should be tax-exempt. Ticket 4628.

maria: Can you drop the invoice id and txn id? I'll pull the invoice.

sam: INV-6832 txn=tx_0a1b2c3d card_bin=411111 billing_addr=NY PO.company=Pacific Labs LLC PO.state=CA PO.tax_cert=CA-RESELL-9922

billing-bot: Invoice INV-6832 created | amount=$12,400 | tax=$930 | customer_id=cust_9876

jordan: @sam assign to me. Is this the same as the 'split-legal-entity' issue we saw last month?

sam: Possibly — customer has two legal entities on account: 'Pacific Labs, Inc (NY HQ)' as billing entity and 'Pacific Labs LLC (CA branch)' on PO. Our tax lookup fell back to card_bin->billing_addr before checking PO.tax_cert.

alex: I can repro in staging. Steps:
1) create customer with billing_addr NY
2) attach PO with company_state=CA and tax_cert
3) charge card with bin 411111
Result: tax applied for NY.
Curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoices \
 -d '{"customer_id":"cust_9876","po":{...},"payment_method":"pm_card_411111"}'
```
Logs: tax_engine:jurisdiction_fallback=[card_bin,billing_address,po_cert]

maria: Thanks. That fallback order is wrong for invoices with PO.tax_cert. We should prefer PO.tax_cert > PO.company_state > billing_address > card_bin.

jordan: Agree. For immediate fix: refund tax portion and issue credit note. I'll create billing action.

sam: Customer requested credit note and corrected invoice. I've opened billing ticket BILL-4628 and created refund tx_ref=ref_77aab. @maria can you patch tax engine rule?

maria: Patch scheduled in deploy-ops for 2026-04-14. I'll add an AB test to ensure no regressions. Also adding a unit test for 3-entity mapping.

billing-bot: Credit note CN-2117 issued | amount=$930 | linked INV-6832 | refund ref_77aab

alex: Deployed fix to staging. Repro passes. Ping me when merged to prod.

jordan: Thanks team. I'll follow up with customer and confirm tax credit. Closing interim loop.
